spec_sources.AN619: AN619 Rev 0.8 (2021-09-23) Manually Generating an Si5351 Register Map for 10-MSOP and 20-QFN Devices

assumptions.unknown_prior_register_bits: assumed 0 (reg 44-style byte bit7, reg 92, reg 3 before reset)
assumptions.spec_bc_choice: spec does not prescribe b/c selection; spec registers are encoded from the library's a/b/c

golden_corrections.reason: multisynth_calc(freq, pll_freq) sees a = pll/freq = 4 < SI5351_MULTISYNTH_A_MIN, clamps freq = pll/6 but does NOT recompute a. The first-draft mirror recomputed a (=6). Registers were never affected because DIVBY4 overrides P1/P2/P3 to 0/0/1; only the reported intermediate changes. Mirror now matches library exactly (also fixes the same pattern in pll_calc).

DEV-01-FOUT-MAX-225.title: Library accepts CLK0-5 output up to 225 MHz; spec max is 200 MHz
DEV-01-FOUT-MAX-225.library: SI5351_MULTISYNTH_MAX_FREQ = 225000000; set_freq clamps to 225 MHz, programs DIVBY4 with fVCO=4*Fout (e.g. 210 MHz -> VCO 840 MHz, 250 MHz request -> 225 MHz/VCO 900 MHz)
DEV-01-FOUT-MAX-225.spec: DS Table 7 FCLK max 200 MHz; AN619 §2 MS output 500 kHz-200 MHz; AN619 §4.1.3 DIVBY4 range 150 < Fout <= 200 MHz

DEV-02-FOUT-MIN-4K.title: Library min CLK0-5 output is 4 kHz; datasheet min is 2.5 kHz
DEV-02-FOUT-MIN-4K.library: SI5351_CLKOUT_MIN_FREQ = 4000; 2.5 kHz request silently becomes 4 kHz (R=128, MS 512 kHz)
DEV-02-FOUT-MIN-4K.spec: DS Table 7 FCLK min 0.0025 MHz; AN619 §2 'down to 2.5 kHz' (note AN619 §4.2.2 says 8 kHz: docs disagree)

DEV-03-CLK67-LOWFREQ-P1-TRUNC.title: CLK6/7 low-frequency request writes MS6_P1 = 0 (uint8 truncation of 256)
DEV-03-CLK67-LOWFREQ-P1-TRUNC.library: set_freq(<18.454 kHz, CLK6/7) clamps to 4 kHz (CLKOUT_MIN, not CLKOUT67_MIN), select_r_div_ms67 picks R=1, multisynth67_calc clamps to 500 kHz, a=254 -> PLL 127 MHz < VCO_MIN -> a+=2 = 256 -> reg->p1=(uint8_t)256 = 0; set_pll(128 MHz) is clamped to 600 MHz inside pll_calc but pllb_freq stores 128 MHz
DEV-03-CLK67-LOWFREQ-P1-TRUNC.spec: AN619 Reg 90/91: MS6/7 ratio even integer 6..254; AN619 §2 VCO 600-900 MHz

DEV-04-MS-RATIO-6-TO-8.title: Library permits output MS ratios in [6,8) other than 6 (odd 7, fractional 6.x, 7.x)
DEV-04-MS-RATIO-6-TO-8.library: multisynth_calc(freq, pll_freq) only clamps a<6 / a>1800; set_freq_manual(100 MHz, 700 MHz) -> ratio 7; (90 MHz, 600 MHz) -> 6.666666

DEV-05-MS-STALE-A.title: multisynth_calc keeps stale a after the a<6 clamp -> programs ratio 5
DEV-05-MS-STALE-A.library: a = pll/freq = 5; freq = pll/6 but a is not recomputed; b = 0 -> P1 = 128 (ratio 5). set_freq_manual(140 MHz, 700 MHz)

DEV-06-DIVBY4-PRECONDITION.title: set_freq_manual forces DIVBY4 for Fout >= 150 MHz regardless of pll_freq
DEV-06-DIVBY4-PRECONDITION.library: set_freq_manual(175 MHz, 800 MHz) writes DIVBY4 (P=0,0,1) -> actual output 200 MHz
DEV-06-DIVBY4-PRECONDITION.spec: AN619 §4.1.3 'Set the appropriate feedback Multisynth to generate fVCO = Fout*4'

DEV-07-VCXO-CENTER-112M5.title: VCXO-linked output above 112.5 MHz (library example si5351_vcxo.ino uses 146 MHz)
DEV-07-VCXO-CENTER-112M5.library: No check; example tunes CLK0 = 146 MHz on VCXO PLLB 876 MHz
DEV-07-VCXO-CENTER-112M5.spec: DS §4.2 'Multisynth ... synthesizes the VCXO output's center frequency up to 112.5 MHz'

DEV-08-VCXO-C-NOT-PRESERVED.title: VCXO requirement c = 10^6 on MSNB is lost after later set_pll() calls
DEV-08-VCXO-C-NOT-PRESERVED.library: set_vcxo() does not update pllb_freq; set_correction()/set_pll_input() re-run set_pll(pllb_freq=800 MHz) -> MSNB a=32,b=0,c=1. set_freq_manual(..., 875 MHz) after set_vcxo(875 MHz) re-runs non-VCXO pll_calc -> b=0 -> c=1
DEV-08-VCXO-C-NOT-PRESERVED.spec: AN619 §3.2 & §7: 'Feedback B Multisynth divider ratio must be set such that ... c ... is fixed to 10^6'

DEV-09-PHOFF-CLK67.title: set_phase(CLK6/7) writes reserved registers 171/172
DEV-09-PHOFF-CLK67.library: si5351_write(SI5351_CLK0_PHASE_OFFSET + clk, phase) with no clk bound
DEV-09-PHOFF-CLK67.spec: AN619 §6 & Reg 165-170: phase offset only for CLK0-5; 171-176 Reserved

DEV-10-XTAL-CL-0PF.title: SI5351_CRYSTAL_LOAD_0PF writes reserved XTAL_CL = 00b
DEV-10-XTAL-CL-0PF.spec: AN619 Reg 183: XTAL_CL 00 'Reserved. Do not select this option.'

DEV-11-SET_INT-CLK67-IS-FB_INT.title: set_int(CLK6/7) toggles FBA_INT/FBB_INT (reg 22/23 bit 6), not an MS6/7 integer bit
DEV-11-SET_INT-CLK67-IS-FB_INT.library: set_int() writes bit 6 of SI5351_CLK0_CTRL+clk for any clk; on fractional PLLA this forces MSNA integer mode
DEV-11-SET_INT-CLK67-IS-FB_INT.spec: AN619 Reg 22/23 bit 6 = FBA_INT/FBB_INT; §3.2.1 only for even-integer feedback; §4.1.2.1 MS6/7 have no INT bit

DEV-12-CLKIN-DIV-RMW.title: set_pll_input ORs CLKIN_DIV into reg 15 without clearing the old field
DEV-12-CLKIN-DIV-RMW.library: reg_val |= clkin_div (the &= ~SI5351_CLKIN_DIV_MASK line is commented out): prior /2 (01b) + new /4 (10b) -> 11b = /8
DEV-12-CLKIN-DIV-RMW.spec: AN619 Reg 15 CLKIN_DIV[1:0] is a 2-bit field (00 /1, 01 /2, 10 /4, 11 /8)

DEV-13-PLL-STALE-A.title: pll_calc keeps stale a after a>90 clamp (non-25/27 MHz reference)
DEV-13-PLL-STALE-A.library: 5 MHz reference: a = 160 > 90, freq clamped to 450 MHz but a not recomputed; P1 = 19968 (ratio 160)
DEV-13-PLL-STALE-A.spec: AN619 §3.2 feedback ratio 15..90; AN619 §3.1.2 PLL input 10-40 MHz; DS Table 6/8 XTAL 25-27 MHz

DEV-14-CLK67-NOT-ENABLED.title: set_freq() on CLK6/CLK7 never enables the output (reg 3 OEB bit stays 1)
DEV-14-CLK67-NOT-ENABLED.library: CLK0-5 branch calls output_enable(clk,1) on first set; CLK6/7 branch has no output_enable(); reset() disabled all outputs

DEV-15-MANUAL-CLK67.title: set_freq_manual() on CLK6/7 writes a truncated fractional-MS P1 to reg 90/91
DEV-15-MANUAL-CLK67.library: set_freq_manual(87.4 MHz, 874 MHz, CLK7): multisynth_calc gives a=10,b=0,c=1 -> P1=128*10-512=768; set_ms writes (uint8_t)768 = 0x00 to reg 91
DEV-15-MANUAL-CLK67.spec: AN619 §4.1.2 / Reg 91: 'For MS6 and MS7, set MSx_P1 directly (e.g., MSx_P1 = divide value)' -> 10 (0x0A)

cases.description: For freq<=100 MHz, set_freq uses existing PLL and does not call set_pll; set_freq_manual always calls set_pll(pll_freq). MS a/b/c and p1/p2/p3 must match when the same pll_freq is supplied. Differences: set_freq_manual always output_enable(1); set_freq enables only on first set. set_freq skips pll_reset in <=100 MHz branch; set_freq_manual does not reset either.

set_freq(175 MHz) chooses pll_freq via multisynth_calc(freq,0) → a=4, pll=700 MHz. set_freq_manual(175 MHz, 700 MHz) must yield identical MS p1/p2/p3, div_by_4=1, int_mode=1 and identical PLL a/b/c when correction matches.
